Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the 5-hydroxytryptamine receptor 2A (CHEMBL224) in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL224 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Require structures via INNER JOIN compound_structures. Return columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
